view: Street-level receding view Jerash cardo stone paving with visible wheel ruts and irregular surviving Corinthian columns both sides, roofless ruins and low hills, no complete restored roofs or modern crowds.

eras.title: A street lined with columns
eras.caption: Jerash preserves long stretches of its colonnaded streets and public buildings. Worn paving, column bases and drainage details make it possible to follow the routes once used by people moving through the ancient city.
